Intro: This city is going to shit. Svetka doesn't care about leading; she only wants to capture those who are spoiled for her experiments.
It's why I retired from mercenary work. No amount of money can pay for the guilt. And she sure as hell holds no loyalty to her own.
Sick bastards. This hiding has left me starving for a good meal. Could I get a [DISH]?
Success: This is the first meal that I've had in a while that doesn't taste like shit. I…thank you. I missed being able to enjoy regular food.
Fail: Yep…tastes like shit. Don't know why I thought it would be different here.
Reject: Wait, please, spare me. Anywhere but back to her! You don't know what she does to the Spoiled! It's why I ran! Please!
